symbols.not_a_buyback: Its only filing is a fluctuating-market (POJK 13/2023) plan disclosed 14 Apr 2025. The 3-month maximum puts its end around mid-Jul 2025, so it is out of scope. There is no 2026 program and no DB row.

The Mar-Apr 2025 'buyback' was the mandatory repurchase from shareholders who disagreed with the XL-Smartfren merger (Article 62 appraisal rights), completed 16 Apr 2025 (2025-04-16 report). It is not a buyback program, and it is out of scope anyway. There is no DB row.
